principles: Film chronology/outcomes remain immutable; optional gameplay fills safe gaps only.
A red critical exact-head gate blocks unrelated feature expansion until repaired.
Player agency should not be removed longer than the presentation actually requires.
Automatic persistence during active play should avoid avoidable disk hitches.
Developer navigation must not ship as ordinary player controls.
Repeated environment detail should prefer instancing/culling over actor proliferation.
Hot-path actor enumeration and synchronous loads require measurement and explicit ownership.
Machine success never substitutes for rendered PIE/device/human acceptance.

findings.title: World material persistence is unreliable
findings.evidence: Unreal #594 on 38c2c958121576b68a0bfaf4e276498d4fe89dad passed UE4.27.2 C++ build, deterministic production import, Automation, startup and P1C01-P1C08. M_ProductionSurface was resident and CharacterSurfaceAudit passed. The workflow then failed in the persistence state gate, so the final warning-debt/material-persistence step remained skipped.
findings.action: Complete the persistence repair on a fresh exact head, then require the warning-debt/material-persistence gate to execute. Do not add another material recovery path unless that gate identifies a concrete package defect.

findings.title: Cinematic mode could lock movement for up to 27 seconds
findings.evidence: Presentation durations include RingWarning=27s while current camera framing is only a few seconds.
findings.action: Cap lightweight presentation input lock at 3.5s while dialogue/audio continue.

findings.title: Developer chapter/route controls were bound in all builds
findings.evidence: F6/F7/F8 debug navigation bindings were unconditional.
findings.action: Bind developer chapter/route controls only in non-shipping builds.

findings.title: Automatic checkpoints used synchronous disk writes during active gameplay
findings.action: Use queued AsyncSaveGameToSlot for automatic checkpoints; keep CI disk roundtrip deterministic.

findings.title: NPC social pairing uses distributed actor iteration
findings.evidence: Ambient NPCs perform two TActorIterator scans and named companion banter performs another.
findings.action: Profile target-device game-thread cost; move candidate lookup to a central registry/director if cost becomes material.

findings.title: Chapter builders perform many direct LoadObject calls
findings.evidence: All inspected non-engine runtime LoadObject paths have been removed from the current branch: chapter world builders now resolve only asynchronously resident bank assets; player/named-NPC/enemy production visuals use resident soft resolution; ShireAudioSubsystem no longer LoadObject<USoundBase>. Remaining direct LoadObject calls are limited to tiny /Engine/BasicShapes fallback assets and are guarded by deep_project_audit.py.
findings.action: Fresh Pre-Unreal must pass, then runner recovery must provide UE4.27 compile/import/startup/transition evidence. Measure transition hitch and resident memory before closing performance acceptance.

findings.title: Ambient living-world actors use spawn/cull/destroy churn
findings.evidence: LivingWorldDirector now owns bounded ambient-NPC reuse and AShireAmbientNPC deactivation disables tick/visibility/collision and clears social state. Destroy paths remain for non-pooled/excess/event actors, so target-device Spawn/Destroy/GC measurement is still required.
findings.action: Do not increase population because pooling exists. Validate exact head and measure churn/GC on target hardware; extend pooling only to proven hot ephemeral classes while keeping named persistent NPC identity out of the pool.

findings.title: Chapter router scans world actors during teardown
findings.evidence: GetAllActorsOfClass is used at chapter rebuild, not every frame.
findings.action: Accept at current scale; migrate to owned generated-actor registries if teardown cost grows.

findings.title: Save/route validation performs real isolated disk roundtrip
findings.evidence: Current CI mutates, writes, loads, verifies and deletes a unique save slot.

findings.title: NPC context can advance to destination story/world context before visible world commit
findings.evidence: ChapterWorldRouter now publishes committed chapter/route/episode/revision plus committed quest snapshot to UShireNPCContextSubsystem on normal commit and rollback. Regional mood/profile availability use committed identity; danger uses live quest only while logical and committed world identities match; new bounded dialogue/film-context selection is suppressed during the async mismatch window.
findings.action: After runner recovery, execute a forced slow transition and assert that old-world NPCs never expose destination mood/dialogue before OnWorldCommitted, while same-world quest-stage reactions still update.

findings.title: Character rig async handles can accumulate for the full GameInstance lifetime
findings.evidence: Character rigs use async soft paths; completed handles release after actor-owned handoff; requests now call FPackageName::DoesPackageExist for mesh+AnimBP packages once per GameInstance and do not RequestAsyncLoad absent future-production packages. This removes the missing-package engine error flood seen in Build #547 while preserving modular fallback.
findings.action: Fresh exact-head compile/runtime proof, then multi-chapter memory/GC measurement once real skeletal FBX rigs exist.

findings.title: Chapter spawn coordinates could drift onto collision seams
findings.evidence: Unreal #594 on 38c2c958121576b68a0bfaf4e276498d4fe89dad executed the aggregate P1C01-P1C08 chapter sweep with attempted=8 expected=8 failed=[]; the former P1C05 no-blocking-ground symptom did not recur.
findings.action: Keep the shared bounded grounding invariant and no-support-pad guard. Later confirm the original traversal symptom in rendered PIE/device review before final visual/traversal acceptance.

findings.title: Chapter runtime CI hid later failures by stopping at the first red chapter
findings.evidence: Unreal #594 completed all eight chapter audits in one run and emitted RUNTIME_SWEEP_SUMMARY with failed=[].
findings.action: Preserve the non-fail-fast aggregate sweep as a permanent regression guard.

findings.title: Legacy texture format and duplicate OBJ face vertices created avoidable import debt
findings.evidence: The source bank contained 24 BMP textures and seven OBJ files with 304 total triangulation-risk faces caused by consecutive duplicate-position face vertices. Those defects corresponded with large UE import tangent/binormal warning volume.
findings.action: All 24 BMP files are migrated to TGA with MTL references updated; BMP is now rejected. Duplicate face vertices were removed from all seven known source meshes and triangulation-risk faces are now strict asset-audit errors. Re-run import and warning debt on exact head.

findings.title: Save restore published quest identity before all persistent domains were rebuilt
findings.evidence: RestoreSaveSnapshot called RestoreQuestState first; that method immediately broadcast route/chapter/quest events before NPC memory, discoveries, progression and map/chronicle knowledge were restored. Unreal #594 also showed disk write/load/restore succeeded but final verification failed without field-level diagnostics.
findings.action: Use BeginPersistenceRestore/CommitPersistenceRestore so all logical domains rebuild before one publication boundary; rollback publishes only after old geometry/player placement is rebuilt. State CI now reports exact failed persistence fields and seeds real NPC memory.

findings.title: Already-resident chapter bank could cause a false asset-commit failure
findings.evidence: RequestChapterAssets returns OnChapterAssetsReady immediately for an already-resident chapter/route after cancelling pending state, but CommitPendingRequest previously required matching PendingChapterId/PendingRouteId. Same-bank episode/save transitions could therefore roll back despite valid residency.
findings.action: CommitPendingRequest now accepts an already-resident matching bank and republishes the residency-commit signal. Add exact-head same-bank transition coverage.

findings.title: Cancelled asynchronous audio callbacks could still execute stale playback
findings.evidence: CancelPendingAudioCategory removed/cancelled handles, but HandleAsyncAudioReady did not verify that LoadKey was still owned before resolving/playing the completed request.
findings.action: Late callbacks now return unless PendingAudioLoads still owns LoadKey. Keep audio runtime acceptance separate because CI currently runs with -NoSound.

external_practice_alignment.basis: Epic UE4.27 recommends AsyncSaveGameToSlot for active-play saves.

external_practice_alignment.project_action: V5 chapter/route soft-path async preload is implemented as a guarded source/runtime mitigation; exact-head engine proof and target-device measurement remain required before performance promotion.
external_practice_alignment.basis: Epic recommends soft references/asynchronous loading to reduce stalls and memory pressure.

external_practice_alignment.project_action: retain/expand instancing for repeated non-interactive detail
external_practice_alignment.basis: Unreal instancing reduces repeated actor/object/draw-call cost.
UE4 performance guidance emphasizes profiling actual target workloads.
